name: Data-centre fibre
kid: Short glass cables between the boxes in one building, all belonging to the same company.
nerd: Inside the fabric: 100–400G Ethernet over short single-mode fibre (or copper for the last metres to a server).

1995.kid: Drawn as today’s short glass cables. In 1995 the server room was wired with thin copper cables.
1995.nerd: Drawn as today (100–400G Ethernet over fibre). In 1995 a server room was wired with 10 Mbit/s Ethernet over copper (10BASE-T), through a hub.
